text:
sophie_partners: Quick sync — we need a short stability bakeoff for the Delta connector across Snowflake, Databricks Delta, and our vector DB adapters (Qdrant/Milvus) before the marketplace listing. Goal: reproducible ingest for retail POC + no >1% error for 24h. Who can own infra the week of Apr 6?

julio_eng: I can own the harness and run experiments on our staging cluster. I'll need the sample S3 path and a list of target configs (Snowflake warehouse sizes, DBX cluster types, vector shard counts).

tara_pm: Assign to Julio for infra. I'll coordinate partner access with Snow and Databricks. Ben — can sales/partner ops push for earlier test creds from Snowflake side? :pray:

ben_sales: pinged Snow partner contact (cc @snow-poc). They said they can provide a dev account but need the test plan. I'll attach our one-pager later. :thumbsup:

chris_sre: For reliability signals, we'll capture: p50/p95 ingest latency, per-partition backpressure, connector restart rates, and file-drop failures. Need a tracing prefix so we can filter logs: use `bakeoff-2912`. Also set alerting to ignore transient restarts during deploys.

evan_ml: Dataset: use retail-sample-10M (s3://redwood-poc/retail-sample-10m). Please keep schema stable (product_id, ts, event_type, embedding). Will provide embedding model snapshot.

olivia_qadb: I can run the vector DB side: create Qdrant and Milvus clusters, run index builds and measure query latency under concurrent ingest. Will log index build failures.

julio_eng: Test matrix draft:
```
- targets: snowflake, databricks-delta, snowbridge->qdrant, databricks->milvus
- warehouse/cluster sizes: small/medium/large
- concurrency: 4, 16, 64
- batch-size: 256, 2048
- duration: 6h warmup + 24h soak
- metrics: p50/p95 token latency, ingest throughput (rows/s), error-rate, connector uptime
```

julio_eng: Ingest command (harness):
```
python infra/ingest.py \
  --dataset s3://redwood-poc/retail-sample-10m \
  --target {{target}} \
  --concurrency 16 \
  --batch-size 2048 \
  --trace-prefix bakeoff-2912
```

chris_sre: Put the commands in a reproducible job (k8s CronJob) and tag nodes with `bakeoff`. I'll reserve 4 c5/g5 nodes for the tests. If you need GPUs for embedding builds, tell me how many.

sophie_partners: Hardware partners: we should try one run on AuroraHW A100 pool (they offered early access) to validate index build times. Julio — can you add an A100 config to the matrix?

julio_eng: Yes — adding `hw: a100-aurora` to matrix.

integrations-bot: Test harness repo updated: https://git.internal/rw/ingest-harness/commit/5f2a7c. New flag `--index-timeout` added.

olivia_qadb: Quick note: Qdrant needs `flush_interval=5s` for low-latency reads during ingest, Milvus can't handle >8k concurrent inserts without sharding changes — might need to throttle.

ev an_ml: For success criteria: if any adapter shows sustained >1% error or connector restart >2/day, fail. Also compare cost proxy (tokens/rows per $) between Snow and DBX runs.

tara_pm: Timeline: finalize plan by Mon (2912346000), run tests Wed–Thu, embargoed partner report Fri. Ben will handle partner comms.

ben_sales: Drafted partner one-pager and sent to Sophie for review. Will ask Snow for a dev warehouse `X-SnowPart` and DBX for `m5.xlarge` cluster.

julio_eng: Starting infra prep now. I'll push the matrix to the repo and open PR for k8s jobs. Expecting creds from Ben by EOD tomorrow.

olivia_qadb: I'll prepare dashboards in Grafana: ingest rate, error rate, index latency, and vector query p95. Share links when ready.

sophie_partners: Perfect. Keep updates concise here — post a short summary when each run completes (timestamped). Thanks everyone :rocket:
